request.prompt:
Goods: LED colour television receiver 55in 4K UHD
Country of origin: MX

Chosen so far: 85 Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8528: Monitors and projectors, not incorporating television reception apparatus; reception apparatus for television, whether or not incorporating radio-broadcast receivers or sound or video recording or reproducing apparatus

    contains 852873: Reception apparatus for television, whether or not incorporating radio-broadcast receivers or sound or video recording or reproducing apparatus; incorporating a monochrome video display or screen

    contains 852859: Monitors other than cathode-ray tube; n.e.c. in subheading 8528.52, whether or not colour
    contains 852869: Projectors; n.e.c. in subheading 8528.62, whether or not colour

    contains 854040: Tubes; data/graphic display tubes, monochrome; data/graphic display tubes, colour, with a phosphor dot screen pitch smaller than 0.4mm
    contains 854012: Tubes; cathode-ray television picture tubes, including video monitor cathode-ray tubes, monochrome

data.reason: A complete LED colour television receiver with a 55-inch screen is a television reception apparatus incorporating a colour display, which falls in heading 8528 (subheading 8528.72).
